title: A Phlorotanin, 6,6'-bieckol from Ecklonia cava, Against Photoaging by Inhibiting MMP-1, -3 and -9 Expression on UVB-induced HaCaT Keratinocytes.
authors: He, Yuan-Lin; Xiao, Zhenbang; Yang, Shengtao; Zhou, Chunxia; Sun, Shengli; Hong, Pengzhi; Qian, Zhong-Ji
one_liner_zh: 该文研究褐藻多酚6,6'-bieckol对UVB诱导皮肤光老化的保护作用，涉及MMP抑制与分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Skin is the outmost layer of human and sustains most of the external UVB irradiation, which possibly causes the skin photoaging. As a natural antioxidant, marine natural products have been paid more and more attention to their positive effects on photoaging. 6,6'-bieckol is a phlorotanin isolated from Ecklonia cava, while its antiphotoaging bioactivity and mechanism have not been clear yet. This study proves that 6,6'-bieckol enhances cells viability and decreases the level of ROS in UVB-induced human immortalized keratinocytes (HaCaT) cells. It also resulted in significant downregulation of matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs), p-c-Fos, phosphorylated JNK, p38, IkappaB and p65. In addition, molecular docking also showed that 6,6'-bieckol could bind to MMP-1, MMP-3 and MMP-9. Finally, it was proved that 6,6'-bieckol acts on MMPs through the MAPK/AP-1 and NF-kappaB pathways to reduce UVB-induced oxidative stress damage in HaCaT cells. Therefore, 6,6'-bieckol is a functional food and skin care ingredient with great potential in preventing photoaging.
abstract_zh: 皮肤是人体最外层组织，承受了大部分外部UVB辐射，这可能导致皮肤光老化。作为一种天然抗氧化剂，海洋天然产物在光老化方面的积极作用日益受到关注。6,6'-双鹅掌菜酚（6,6'-bieckol）是从鹅掌菜（Ecklonia cava）中分离出的褐藻多酚，但其抗光老化生物活性及机制尚不明确。本研究证明，6,6'-bieckol能增强UVB诱导的人永生化角质形成细胞（HaCaT）的细胞活力，并降低ROS水平。同时，它还显著下调了基质金属蛋白酶（MMPs）、p-c-Fos、磷酸化JNK、p38、IkappaB和p65的表达。此外，分子对接（molecular docking）也显示6,6'-bieckol能与MMP-1、MMP-3和MMP-9结合。最终，研究证明6,6'-bieckol通过MAPK/AP-1和NF-kappaB通路作用于MMPs，从而减轻UVB诱导的HaCaT细胞氧化应激损伤。因此，6,6'-bieckol是一种在预防光老化方面具有巨大潜力的功能性食品和护肤成分。
